en.timetableImport.title: Import a timetable
en.timetableImport.subtitle: Photograph your masjid's printed timetable and check the times before saving.
en.timetableImport.tvNote: Import a timetable from the app on your phone. Your times then show here too.
en.timetableImport.unavailableBody: This version of the app can't read photos on this device. You can still type your masjid's times.
en.timetableImport.onDevice: Processed on your phone — the photo is never uploaded
en.timetableImport.inBrowser: Processed in this browser — the photo is never uploaded
en.timetableImport.reviewHint: Highlighted cells were hard to read or look unusual for your location. Fix anything that's wrong, or clear a cell to leave it out.
en.timetableImport.monthTitle: Which month is this sheet for?
en.timetableImport.outOfMonth: Some rows are past the end of this month and won't be saved. Check the month.
en.timetableImport.fixInvalid_one: {{count}} time isn't in HH:MM format yet.
en.timetableImport.fixInvalid_other: {{count}} times aren't in HH:MM format yet.
en.timetableImport.emptyBody: We couldn't find Salah names and times in that photo. Try a sharper, straight-on photo of just the table, or type the times.
en.timetableImport.errorBody: Something went wrong while reading the photo. Try again, or type the times.
en.timetableImport.captureTitle: Take a photo of the timetable
en.timetableImport.intro: Import the iqamah times for {{name}} from a printed daily board or monthly sheet.
en.timetableImport.tips: Lay the sheet flat, fill the frame with the table, and avoid glare. Crop to the table if you can.
en.timetableImport.webDownload: The first time, your browser downloads about {{size}} MB of text-reading data from jsDelivr (a public CDN). Only the data is downloaded — your photo stays in this browser.
en.timetableImport.webCached: Text-reading data is already saved in this browser.
en.timetableImport.keepPhoto: Keep the photo while I check
en.timetableImport.keepPhotoHint: Shows the photo next to the times. It's deleted when you save or leave.
en.timetableImport.cameraDenied: Camera access is off. Turn it on in Settings, or choose a photo instead.
en.timetableImport.privacy: Times you import are saved as Your times for your home masjid: private to your devices, never shared with other users.
en.timetableImport.nothingToSave: There are no iqamah times to save yet.
en.timetableImport.invalidHint: Type the time as HH:MM, for example 13:30.
en.masjids.times.importHint: Reads the times on your phone. The photo is never uploaded.
en.timetableImport.flag.columnUnclear: Column heading unclear — check which Salah this is
en.timetableImport.beginsOnly: This sheet only lists start (Adhan) times, so no iqamah times were taken from it. Type your masjid's iqamah times below.
en.timetableImport.monthWrap: This sheet runs into the next month. Check that the month above is the month the sheet starts in.
en.timetableImport.dateColumnBody: This sheet has more than one column of day numbers. Pick the one with the day of the month — not the Ramadan or Hijri day.
